New build, conversion and refurbishment

Much of our work is in buildings that are hard to work in: occupied blocks, tight sites, old structures and fixed deadlines. We coordinate design, structure, services and finishes, and see the job through to building control sign-off.

We work under JCT contracts and design and build arrangements, as main contractor or principal contractor.

  • Basement constructionExcavation, underpinning, waterproofing, drainage and fit-out.
  • Commercial refurbishmentOffices, retail, hospitality and leisure, including structural alterations and fit-out.
  • Design and buildDesign, pricing, programme and construction under one managed route.
  • Extensions, vertical extensions and loft conversionsNew storeys and extensions, including work above occupied buildings.
  • Listed buildingsCareful alteration and refurbishment of listed and sensitive buildings.
  • Mixed-use developmentsHomes and commercial space within one building project.
  • New buildHouses and apartment blocks from groundworks to handover.
  • Residential refurbishmentLayout changes, structural works, services, kitchens, bathrooms and finishes.
  • Student accommodationConversion and fit-out of student rooms, with fire safety works and building services.

Selected projects

Four rooftop penthouses, Cricklewood NW2

JCT contract, completed 2017

Four new penthouse flats built on the roof of a 1930s mansion block of 24 flats, with every resident in occupation throughout. Two new lifts were installed in the altered original shafts and the staircases were extended to the new floor.

  • Built above 24 occupied flats
  • Two new lifts and extended staircases
  • Communal areas, facade and electrics refurbished under a separate Section 20 programme
See the Cricklewood photographs

Mercia Lodge student rooms, Coventry

Design and build, completed August 2016

The unused second floor of a former hotel in Coventry city centre converted into 19 self-contained student rooms, taking the building to 169 rooms, to a fixed deadline for student arrivals.

  • 21 roof lights cut through the concrete roof on new steelwork
  • New hot and cold water and drainage to every room
  • Building control final certificate, August 2016
See the Coventry photographs

A basement converted into a cinema room, gym and wine cellar, with full waterproofing and natural light brought below ground.

Construction questions

What construction projects do you take on?

We deliver new builds, residential refurbishments, commercial refurbishments, basements, extensions, vertical extensions, loft conversions, mixed-use schemes, listed buildings and complex conversions.

Do you provide design and build services?

Yes. We can coordinate design, consultants, specification, pricing and construction delivery under one managed route, giving clients one accountable team.

Can you manage complex structural works?

Yes, where supported by suitable structural design. We coordinate temporary works, sequencing, specialist packages and practical site requirements.

Can you work with developers, lenders and professional teams?

Yes. We regularly work with developers, investors, asset managers, consultants, funders and private clients where programme control and delivery confidence matter.

Can you work on listed or sensitive buildings?

Yes. These projects need tighter control around existing fabric, approvals, sequencing, protection and specialist trades.

Can works be phased around occupied properties?

Where feasible, yes. We plan access, temporary protection, noisy works and service interruptions with the client and design team.

Do you handle commercial fit-out and refurbishment?

Yes. We deliver commercial refurbishment, fit-out, structural alterations, finishing packages, property services and maintenance-related works.

Can you reduce disruption to trading or tenants?

We can plan phasing, access, logistics and working hours to reduce disruption where the building remains live or partially occupied.

Do you deliver CAT A and CAT B style works?

Yes. We can support landlord-ready shell works and more detailed occupier fit-out scopes, depending on specification and drawings.

What residential projects do you take on?

We work across property development, basements, extensions, vertical extensions, loft conversions, refurbishments, new builds, HMO conversions, high-spec fit-outs and long-term property enhancement.

Can you work with private clients and developers?

Yes. We can support private homeowners, developers, investors, portfolio owners and professional teams where quality, programme and coordination matter.

Can you help improve layouts and finishes?

We can contribute practical buildability and finish sequencing advice alongside the architect, designer or client specification.

Can you manage the full property project process?

Yes. We can manage planning support, design coordination, site setup, programming, procurement, subcontractors, quality checks, client updates and handover documentation.

How do you keep clients informed?

We agree the communication rhythm early, then provide clear updates around progress, decisions, risks, programme and next actions.

In more detail: Design and build contractor, Basement construction, Extensions, vertical extensions and loft conversions, Commercial refurbishment and fit-out, Listed building refurbishment, Student accommodation and HMO conversion.
